data_table.description: Sample ID, time in fixative, analyte type, tissue bank [tumor tissue and surrounding normal tissue], specimen barcode ID, blood collection, primary organ with tumor, diagnostic pathology report, % of tumor tissue in sample, time the tissue sample was frozen in liquid nitrogen, fixation time, surgical tissue collection and preservation procedure, dimensions of tissue, specimen barcode ID, histologic grade, histological type, tumor status of sample, % of necrosis in the sample of tumor, dimensions of tissue, specimen barcode ID, pathologic spread distant metastases, pathologic spread lymph nodes, tumor stage, pathologic spread primary tumor, % of non-cellular component, number of tumor epithelial cell nuclei as compared to all cell nuclei, % of tumor stroma, % of gross hemolysis of plasma observed, experimental protocol, weight of resection, dimensions of resection, temperature of pathology gross room when specimen arrived, sample description, sample type, % of sarcomatoid features, histologic profile, and weight of frozen tumor block of participants with different type of cancer and involved in the "National Cancer Institute (NCI) Biospecimen Pre-analytical Variables (BPV) Analysis" project.
